target_customer: Product teams and non-designers who need designs and UI code without a professional designer
problem: Non-designers such as engineers and marketers cannot easily produce good product designs. Noya started as a wireframe tool that produced high-fidelity designs and React code using a design system.
business_model: Design software, pricing not stated in sources opened
product_category: Product design and collaborative app tools

founders.name: Devin Abbott
previous_startups: Design tools startup acquired by Airbnb in 2017
founders.background_notes: YC page says open source projects with over 15,000 GitHub stars.

founders.name: David (surname not given on YC page)
previous_startups: Design tools startup acquired by Airbnb in 2017
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background.

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser-based design editor that maps wireframe blocks to design system components and generates React code is a substantial rendering and tooling build for a team of two.

defensibility.rationale: Design tool market is dominated by Figma, and no data or network effects are documented. The founders' prior design tools expertise is an advantage but not a structural moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source opened describes how Figma or others responded to Noya.

market_need_then: The founders' own experience building design tools at Airbnb showed demand to let non-designers design within a design system. No external demand data was found.

branding.community_and_virality: Show HN launch post exists; founder has open source following per YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Short distinctive name with some developer visibility, but no press or community evidence about the brand itself.

pivots.to: Open platform of modular collaborative apps
pivots.why: Not stated in sources opened; date unknown

outcome_analysis: Noya is active with a team of two per the YC page. The founders had already sold a design tools startup to Airbnb in 2017 and worked on its design tools team, which is strong founder market fit. The product has moved from wireframing to a broader platform of collaborative apps, and no verified funding or traction data was found, so the outcome remains open.
notes: CB Insights snippet says $500K over 3 rounds including a May 2023 seed with NJP Ventures; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded. No dated 2023 competitor source opened; later comparison pages list Uizard, Visily, UX Pilot and Galileo AI but those are undated listicles. The pivot is inferred from comparing the launch post to the current homepage; the date is unknown. Outcome search returned nothing relevant.
